figures_added.what: Balance-scale figure at the start of guided.opener.display: a level beam on a fulcrum, left pan holding two bags each labelled x plus a 3kg weight, right pan holding an 11kg weight. Matches the opener numbers exactly (2x + 3 = 11, giving x = 4 via the two boxes 11-3=8 and 8/2=4). Theme-safe (currentColor strokes/text, soft fills #60a5fa/#f59e0b/#34d399 with fill-opacity), viewBox + role=img + aria-label, self-contained, ~1.4KB. Satisfies the 'show what you say' rule since the opener text refers to a balance.

notes: Solving Linear Equations is a purely textual algebra topic. Applying the exam-realism test: a real GCSE paper prints NO figure for 'Solve 2x + 5 = 13' style items, so no bank problem receives a figure (0 missed opportunities). The only figure is the opener hook, drawn programmatically to match its own numbers. All 20 bank displays are plain equations. Validator PASS on live data; the four labels (x, x, 3kg, 11kg) cross-checked against the opener equation 2x + 3 = 11 and its solution x = 4.
